config_fields.name: master_id
config_fields.help: Your ESM+ master id; sent as the JWT header `kid` (selling-tool vendors put their own master id here). https://etapi.gmarket.com/pages/API-가이드

config_fields.name: site_seller_ids
config_fields.help: The JWT `ssi` claim: site id + seller id pairs, e.g. 'A:myauctionid,G:mygmarketid' (A = Auction, G = Gmarket; one of each at most).

config_fields.name: site_type
config_fields.help: Site whose orders list_orders reads: 1 = Auction, 2 = Gmarket (RequestOrders siteType).

fields.name: secret_key
fields.help: ESM Trading API Secret Key issued by Gmarket after the e-mail application (etapihelp@gmail.com); signs the HS256 JWT sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <JWT>' on every call. Never sent on the wire.

me.note: Carrier list (deliveryCompanies[{deliveryCompCode, deliveryCompName}]); verifies the JWT and API permission. The codes are what mark_shipped's `carrier` takes.

list_orders.note: 주문조회 API (RequestOrders) by payment date. Both `status` (paid = 결제완료/new, preparing = 배송준비중, shipping = 배송중, delivered = 배송완료, completed = 구매결정완료) and `since` (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 31 days before today on Gmarket, 180 on Auction) are required by the API; the window ends today. Claim orders (cancel/return/exchange) are not listed. Rate limit: one call per 5 seconds. OrderStatus in results: 1 new, 2 awaiting shipment, 3 shipping, 4 delivered, 5 purchase decided.

mark_shipped.note: 발송처리 API: marks a confirmed order as shipped. `carrier` is the numeric DeliveryCompanyCode from `me` (e.g. 10013 CJ대한통운, 10007 한진, 10008 롯데); `tracking_number` is the waybill (InvoiceNo). ShippingDate is the call time (UTC, within the 2-day window). Re-calling updates the shipping info.

update_listing.note: 가격 수정 API: sets the same KRW price (10-won steps) on Gmarket (gmkt) and Auction (iac) for the master product `listing_id` (goodsNo). Only for products on sale. The item APIs report failures as resultCode 1000 with the reason in `status` (e.g. '[IAC] 상품이 없습니다.' when the product is listed on one site only).

set_inventory.note: 재고 수정 API: sets the stock (1 to 99,999) of master product `listing_id` on both Gmarket and Auction. Only single products (no options, not Fulfilment Star Delivery). Failures come back as resultCode 1000 with the reason in `status`.

end_listing.note: 상품 삭제 API: deletes master product `listing_id` on both sites; it must already be 판매중지 (sale stopped), otherwise resultCode 1000 '상품삭제는 요청된 모든 상품이 [판매중지] 상태일 경우에만 가능합니다.' is returned in `status`.

not_offered.create_listing: 상품 등록 API (https://etapi.gmarket.com/20) requires the Gmarket/Auction leaf category codes ('itemBasicInfo > category > site > catCode', Y), shipping place and dispatch-policy numbers ('shipping > policy > placeNo', Y), product-notice codes ('officialNotice > officialNoticeNo', Y), selling periods and isVatFree; the vocabulary's create_listing has none of these inputs, so a valid registration cannot be built.

adapter.terms: ESM Trading API (Gmarket + Auction). Access is granted by Gmarket after an e-mail application with the ESM master id ('신청 승인은 … 내부 지원 리소스 한도 내에서 가능합니다'); calls are also restricted to registered server IPs.

live_check.notes: requires secret_key, master_id, site_seller_ids, site_type; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
